```html
  <header class="header">
    <button data-action="close-password">‹ 정보 확인으로 돌아가기</button>
    <h1>3단계 · 계좌 비밀번호</h1>
  </header>
  <div class="body">
    <div class="card soft">
      <p class="small">돈이 나가는 계좌</p>
      <p><strong>신한 110-000-000000</strong></p>
      <div class="amount">2,160원</div>
    </div>
    <p><strong>이 출금계좌의 비밀번호 4자리</strong>를 입력해주세요.</p>
    <div class="dots" id="pw-dots" aria-label="비밀번호 입력 상태">○○○○</div>
    <p class="small center" id="pw-count" aria-live="polite">0자리 입력됨 · 총 4자리</p>
    <div class="pad" id="pwpad"></div>
    <div class="row">
      <button data-action="pw-shuffle">숫자 위치 바꾸기</button>
      <button data-action="pw-del">한 자리 지우기</button>
    </div>
    <button class="wide" data-action="pw-clear">모두 지우기</button>
  </div>
  <div class="footer">
    <p id="pw-help">4자리 입력 후 납부 버튼을 눌러주세요.</p>
    <button class="wide primary" id="submit-payment" data-action="submit-payment" disabled>2,160원 납부하기</button>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="screen" data-screen="done">
  <div class="status"><span>4:31</span><span>배터리 67%</span></div>
  <header class="header">
    <div class="nav"><button data-action="finish">홈</button><button data-action="oos-done-support">고객센터</button></div>
    <h1>납부 결과</h1>
  </header>
  <div class="body">
    <div class="success">✓</div>
    <h2 class="center">납부가 완료되었어요</h2>
    <div class="card soft">
      <h2>전기요금 · 홍길동</h2>
      <div class="amount"><span id="dn-paid">2,160</span>원</div>
      <dl class="data"><dt>출금계좌</dt><dd id="dn-acc">신한 110-000-000000</dd></dl>
      <dl class="data"><dt>납부일</dt><dd>2026.08.07 10:11</dd></dl>
      <dl class="data"><dt>전자납부번호 · 고객번호</dt><dd id="dn-eno">1700000000</dd></dl>
    </div>
    <button class="wide" data-action="done-detail" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="done-details">납부 상세정보 펼치기</button>
    <div class="card" id="done-details" hidden>
      <dl class="data"><dt>고객명</dt><dd>홍길동</dd></dl>
      <dl class="data"><dt>청구연월</dt><dd>202607 · 2026년 7월</dd></dl>
      <dl class="data"><dt>고객전용 지정 입금계좌</dt><dd>31500000000000</dd></dl>
      <dl class="data"><dt>고객주소</dt><dd>○○동 ●●●-●</dd></dl>
    </div>
    <p class="notice">입금할 수 없는 계좌인 경우 출금계좌로 재입금됩니다. 나중에 재입금되면 납부내역에서 상태를 확인하세요.</p>
    <button class="wide" data-action="payment-history">납부내역 조회</button>
  </div>
  <div class="footer"><button class="wide primary" data-action="finish">홈으로 돌아가기</button></div>
</section>

<section class="screen" data-screen="service">
  <div class="status"><span>4:31</span><span>배터리 67%</span></div>
  <header class="header">
    <button data-action="service-back">‹ 원래 화면으로 돌아가기</button>
    <h1 id="service-title">서비스 안내</h1>
  </header>
  <div class="body">
    <div class="card soft">
      <h2 id="service-heading">이용 안내</h2>
      <p id="service-message">현재 이 기능을 이용할 수 없습니다. 원래 화면으로 돌아가 다른 업무를 계속해주세요.</p>
    </div>
    <div id="logout-confirm" hidden>
      <p>로그아웃하면 진행하던 납부가 중단됩니다.</p>
      <button class="wide primary" data-action="logout-execute">로그아웃하기</button>
      <button class="wide" data-action="service-back">취소 · 원래 화면으로</button>
    </div>
    <button class="wide" data-action="service-back">원래 화면으로 돌아가기</button>
    <button class="wide" data-action="service-menu">전체메뉴 보기</button>
    <button class="wide" data-action="service-support">고객센터 안내</button>
    <div class="card" id="support-guide" hidden>
      <h3>고객센터 이용 안내</h3>
      <p>전체메뉴의 고객센터 분야에서 전화상담, 영업점 안내, 이용안내를 찾을 수 있어요.</p>
      <button class="wide" data-action="support-menu">고객센터 메뉴 보기</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
</div>
<script>
(function(){
  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const P = window.PRESERVED || {};
  const tabs = P.MENU_TABS || [];
  const lists = [
    P.MENU_BANK || [], P.MENU_CARD || [], P.MENU_STOCK || [],
    P.MENU_INSURE || [], P.MENU_BENEFIT || [], P.MENU_GOODS || [],
    P.MENU_HELP || []
  ];
  const bills = P.BILL_ITEMS || [];
  const keys = P.PW_KEYS || [];
  const state = {
    screen:'home',tab:0,from:'menu',serviceFrom:'home',
    pw:'',checked:false,photo:false,busy:false
  };
  const normalize = v => String(v).replace(/\s/g,'').toLowerCase();

  function button(label, action, dataset){
    const b = document.createElement('button');
    b.type = 'button';
    b.textContent = label;
    b.dataset.action = action;
    Object.entries(dataset || {}).forEach(([k,v]) => {
      b.dataset[k] = String(v);
    });
    return b;
  }

  function groupList(values){
    const groups = [];
    let current = null;
    Array.from(values).forEach(value => {
      const text = String(value);
      if(text.charAt(0) === '#'){
        current = {name:text.slice(1),items:[]};
        groups.push(current);
      }else{
        if(!current){
          current = {name:'업무',items:[]};
          groups.push(current);
        }
        current.items.push(text);
      }
    });
    return groups;
  }

  function show(name){
    if(state.screen==='password' && name!=='password'){
      state.pw='';
      renderPw();
    }
    document.querySelectorAll('#phone .screen').forEach(s=>{
      s.classList.toggle('on',s.dataset.screen===name);
    });
    state.screen=name;
  }
  window.__screen=()=>state.screen;

  function openService(title, logout){
    if(state.screen!=='service') state.serviceFrom=state.screen;
    $('service-title').textContent=title;
    $('service-heading').textContent=logout?'로그아웃할까요?':title;
    $('service-message').textContent=logout
      ?'진행하던 업무를 중단하고 로그아웃할지 선택해주세요.'
      :'현재 이 기능을 이용할 수 없습니다. 원래 화면으로 돌아가 다른 업무를 계속해주세요.';
    $('logout-confirm').hidden=!logout;
    $('support-guide').hidden=true;
    show('service');
  }

  function setTab(index){
    state.tab=index;
    document.querySelectorAll('#menu-tabs button').forEach(b=>{
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(Number(b.dataset.index)===index));
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('#menu-groups > div').forEach((d,i)=>{
      d.hidden=i!==index;
    });
  }

  function expandMenu(){
    document.querySelectorAll('#menu-groups > div').forEach(d=>d.hidden=false);
    document.querySelectorAll('#menu-groups .group-list').forEach(d=>d.hidden=false);
    document.querySelectorAll('#menu-groups [data-action="menu-chip"]').forEach(b=>{
      b.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
    });
  }

  const payItem=lists[0].find(v=>normalize(v)==='납부하기')
    || lists[0].find(v=>String(v).charAt(0)!=='#' && normalize(v).includes('납부하기'));

  $('menu-pay').dataset.item=payItem===undefined?'':String(payItem);
  $('search-pay').dataset.item=payItem===undefined?'':String(payItem);
  $('search-pay').dataset.route=payItem===undefined?'':String(payItem);

  tabs.forEach((tab,index)=>{
    const tb=button(String(tab),'menu-tab',{tab:String(tab),index});
    tb.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(index===0));
    $('menu-tabs').append(tb);
  });

  const searchGroups=[];
  lists.forEach((values,index)=>{
    const tab=String(tabs[index]===undefined?'':tabs[index]);
    const field=document.createElement('div');
    field.dataset.field=tab;
    field.hidden=index!==0;
    const heading=document.createElement('h3');
    heading.textContent=tab+' · 분류 선택';
    field.append(heading);

    const groups=groupList(values);
    groups.forEach((group,gi)=>{
      const chip=tab+'::'+group.name;
      const wrap=document.createElement('div');
      wrap.className='group';

      const toggle=button(group.name,'menu-chip',{
        chip,tab,v:chip,target:'menu-list-'+index+'-'+gi
      });
      toggle.className='group-title';
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-controls',toggle.dataset.target);
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-label',group.name);

      const list=document.createElement('div');
      list.id=toggle.dataset.target;
      list.className='group-list';
      list.hidden=true;

      group.items.forEach(item=>{
        const b=button(item,'menu-item',{item,v:item,tab,chip});
        b.className='item';
        list.append(b);
      });

      if(!group.items.length){
        const empty=document.createElement('p');
        empty.className='small';
        empty.textContent='이 분류의 업무 안내를 확인할 수 있어요.';
        const guide=button(group.name,'category-service',{title:group.name});
        guide.className='wide';
        list.append(empty,guide);
      }

      wrap.append(toggle,list);
      field.append(wrap);

      const sw=document.createElement('div');
      sw.className='group';
      const st=button(tab+' · '+group.name,'search-group',{
        chip,tab,target:'search-list-'+index+'-'+gi
      });
      st.className='group-title';
      st.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
      st.setAttribute('aria-controls',st.dataset.target);

      const sl=document.createElement('div');
      sl.id=st.dataset.target;
      sl.className='group-list';
      sl.hidden=true;
      const entries=[];

      group.items.forEach(item=>{
        const b=button(item,'search-hit',{item,route:item,v:item,tab,chip});
        b.className='item';
        const path=document.createElement('span');
        path.className='path';
        path.textContent=tab+' → '+group.name;
        b.append(path);
        sl.append(b);
        entries.push({b,text:item+' '+tab+' '+group.name,item});
      });

      if(!group.items.length){
        const guide=button(group.name,'category-service',{title:group.name});
        guide.className='item';
        sl.append(guide);
        entries.push({b:guide,text:tab+' '+group.name,item:group.name});
      }

      sw.append(st,sl);
      $('search-groups').append(sw);
      searchGroups.push({wrap:sw,toggle:st,list:sl,entries});
    });

    /*
       항목의 존재 여부는 분류 제목과 비교하지 않는다.
       제목과 이름이 같거나 분류 안에 항목이 하나뿐이어도 모두 유지한다.
       각 원본 항목을 다시 대조하여 누락된 항목만 해당 분야에 추가한다.
    */
    const renderedItems=new Set(
      Array.from(field.querySelectorAll('[data-action="menu-item"]'))
        .map(b=>b.dataset.item)
    );
    const unplaced=Array.from(values).map(String)
      .filter(v=>v.charAt(0)!=='#' && !renderedItems.has(v));

    if(unplaced.length){
      const extra=document.createElement('div');
      extra.className='group-list';
      unplaced.forEach(item=>{
        const b=button(item,'menu-item',{item,v:item,tab});
        b.className='item';
        extra.append(b);
      });
      field.append(extra);
    }
    $('menu-groups').append(field);
  });

  function renderSearch(){
    const raw=$('search-input').value;
    const q=normalize(raw);
    let hits=0;
    const alias=!!q && ['공과금','공과','고지서','종이고지서','세금','납부'].some(s=>{
      return normalize(s).includes(q)||q.includes(normalize(s));
    });
    searchGroups.forEach(g=>{
      let count=0;
      g.entries.forEach(e=>{
        const match=!q || normalize(e.text).includes(q)
          || (alias && e.item===String(payItem));
        e.b.hidden=!match;
        if(match)count++;
      });
      hits+=count;
      g.wrap.hidden=!!q&&!count;
      g.list.hidden=!q;
      g.toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(!!q));
    });
    $('search-shortcut').hidden=!!q&&!alias;
    $('search-empty').hidden=!q||hits>0||alias;
    $('search-status').textContent=q
      ?(hits?'“'+raw+'” 검색 결과 '+hits+'개'
        :alias?'공과금 납부 메뉴를 선택해주세요.'
        :'“'+raw+'” 검색 결과가 없어요.')
      :'이름을 입력하거나 아래 목록에서 골라주세요.';
  }

  groupList(bills).forEach(group=>{
    const wrap=document.createElement('div');
    wrap.className='card';
    const h=document.createElement('h3');
    h.textContent=group.name;
    wrap.append(h);
    group.items.forEach(item=>{
      const b=button(item,'pick-bill',{bill:item,v:item});
      b.className='item';
      wrap.append(b);
    });
    $('bill-list').append(wrap);
  });

  function filterBills(){
    const q=normalize($('bill-query').value);
    let count=0;
    document.querySelectorAll('#bill-list .card').forEach(card=>{
      let found=false;
      card.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>{
        b.hidden=!normalize(b.dataset.bill).includes(q);
        if(!b.hidden){found=true;count++;}
      });
      card.hidden=!found;
    });
    $('bill-empty').hidden=count>0;
  }

  function buildPad(values){
    $('pwpad').replaceChildren();
    values.forEach(v=>{
      const b=button(String(v),'pw',{v:String(v)});
      b.setAttribute('aria-label',String(v));
      $('pwpad').append(b);
    });
  }

  function renderPw(){
    $('pw-dots').textContent='●'.repeat(state.pw.length)+'○'.repeat(4-state.pw.length);
    $('pw-count').textContent=state.pw.length+'자리 입력됨 · 총 4자리';
    $('submit-payment').disabled=state.pw.length!==4||state.busy;
    $('pw-help').textContent=state.busy?'납부 처리 중입니다.'
      :state.pw.length===4?'입력을 수정할 수 있어요. 확인 후 납부 버튼을 누르세요.'
      :'4자리 입력 후 납부 버튼을 눌러주세요.';
  }

  function check(value){
    state.checked=value;
    $('review-check').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(value));
    $('review-check').textContent=(value?'✓':'□')+' 고지서 내용과 출금계좌를 확인했어요';
    $('review-next').disabled=!value;
    $('review-help').textContent=value
      ?'다음 단계에서 계좌 비밀번호를 입력합니다.'
      :'전자납부번호·고객명·금액·출금계좌를 확인해주세요.';
  }

  function cameraReset(){
    state.photo=false;
    $('camera-ready').hidden=false;
    $('camera-preview').hidden=true;
    $('camera-shutter').hidden=false;
    $('camera-choices').hidden=true;
    $('camera-guide').textContent='고지서의 번호와 금액이 함께 보이도록 사각형 안에 맞춰주세요.';
  }

  function togglePanel(el,id,closed,opened){
    const panel=$(id);
    panel.hidden=!panel.hidden;
    el.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(!panel.hidden));
    if(closed)el.textContent=panel.hidden?closed:opened;
  }

  function selectMenu(item,source,shortcut){
    if(shortcut || (payItem!==undefined && item===String(payItem))){
      state.from=source;
      show('bill-start');
    }else openService(item);
  }

  $('search-input').addEventListener('input',renderSearch);
  $('bill-query').addEventListener('input',filterBills);

  $('phone').addEventListener('click',function(e){
    const el=e.target.closest('[data-action]');
    if(!el || !this.contains(el) || el.disabled)return;
    const a = el.dataset.action;
    if(a==='go-menu'){show('menu');}
    else if(a==='back-home'){show('home');}
    else if(a==='open-search'){show('search');}
    else if(a==='back-menu'){show('menu');}
    else if(a==='menu-tab'){
      const index=tabs.findIndex(t=>String(t)===el.dataset.tab);
      if(index>=0)setTab(index);
    }
    else if(a==='menu-chip'){togglePanel(el,el.dataset.target);}
    else if(a==='menu-expand-all'){expandMenu();}
    else if(a==='category-reset'){
      setTab(state.tab);
      document.querySelectorAll('#menu-groups .group-list').forEach(d=>d.hidden=true);
      document.querySelectorAll('#menu-groups [data-action="menu-chip"]').forEach(b=>{
        b.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
      });
      $('menu-body').scrollTop=$('category-heading').offsetTop-$('menu-body').offsetTop;
    }
    else if(a==='menu-item'){selectMenu(el.dataset.item,'menu',el.dataset.pay==='true');}
    else if(a==='search-hit'){selectMenu(el.dataset.route||el.dataset.item,'search',el.dataset.pay==='true');}
    else if(a==='category-service'){openService(el.dataset.title);}
    else if(a==='search-group'){togglePanel(el,el.dataset.target);}
    else if(a==='search-expand-all'){
      searchGroups.forEach(g=>{
        if(!g.wrap.hidden){
          g.list.hidden=false;
          g.toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
        }
      });
    }
    else if(a==='search-input'){$('search-input').focus();}
    else if(a==='search-clear'){$('search-input').value='';renderSearch();}
    else if(a==='oos-search-submit'){renderSearch();$('search-input').blur();}
    else if(a==='back-bill-home'){show(state.from);}
    else if(a==='to-bill-home'){show('bill-start');}
    else if(a==='pay-start'){cameraReset();show('camera');}
    else if(a==='bill-toggle'){
      togglePanel(el,'bill-options','공과금 종류 펼치기','공과금 종류 접기');
    }
    else if(a==='bill-query'){$('bill-query').focus();}
    else if(a==='bill-clear'){$('bill-query').value='';filterBills();}
    else if(a==='pick-bill'){openService(el.dataset.bill);}
    else if(a==='shutter'){
      state.photo=true;
      $('camera-ready').hidden=true;
      $('camera-preview').hidden=false;
      $('camera-shutter').hidden=true;
      $('camera-choices').hidden=false;
      $('camera-guide').textContent='촬영한 고지서를 확인해주세요.';
    }
    else if(a==='retake'){cameraReset();}
    else if(a==='use-photo'){
      if(state.photo){check(false);show('review');}
    }
    else if(a==='review-retake'){check(false);cameraReset();show('camera');}
    else if(a==='review-detail'){
      togglePanel(el,'review-details','고지서 상세정보 펼치기','고지서 상세정보 접기');
    }
    else if(a==='account-open'){togglePanel(el,'account-panel');}
    else if(a==='account-select'){
      $('account-panel').hidden=true;
      document.querySelector('[data-action="account-open"]').setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
      check(false);
    }
    else if(a==='review-check'){check(!state.checked);}
    else if(a==='pay'){
      if(state.checked){
        state.pw='';
        state.busy=false;
        renderPw();
        show('password');
      }
    }
    else if(a==='close-password'){show('review');}
    else if(a==='pw'){
      if(!state.busy && state.pw.length<4){state.pw+=el.dataset.v;renderPw();}
    }
    else if(a==='pw-del'){
      if(!state.busy){state.pw=state.pw.slice(0,-1);renderPw();}
    }
    else if(a==='pw-clear'){
      if(!state.busy){state.pw='';renderPw();}
    }
    else if(a==='pw-shuffle'){
      if(!state.busy){
        const shuffled=Array.from(keys);
        for(let i=shuffled.length-1;i>0;i--){
          const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));
          [shuffled[i],shuffled[j]]=[shuffled[j],shuffled[i]];
        }
        buildPad(shuffled);
      }
    }
    else if(a==='submit-payment'){
      if(state.pw.length===4 && !state.busy){
        state.busy=true;
        renderPw();
        show('done');
        state.busy=false;
      }
    }
    else if(a==='done-detail'){
      togglePanel(el,'done-details','납부 상세정보 펼치기','납부 상세정보 접기');
    }
    else if(a==='payment-history'){openService('납부내역 조회');}
    else if(a==='finish'){check(false);show('home');}
    else if(a==='other-service'){openService(el.dataset.title);}
    else if(a==='service-back'){show(state.serviceFrom);}
    else if(a==='service-menu'){show('menu');}
    else if(a==='service-support'){$('support-guide').hidden=false;}
    else if(a==='support-menu'){
      const i=tabs.findIndex(t=>String(t)==='고객센터');
      if(i>=0)setTab(i);
      show('menu');
    }
    else if(a==='logout-execute'){
      state.pw='';
      check(false);
      cameraReset();
      show('home');
    }
    else if(a==='oos-home' || a==='oos-info-home' || a==='oos-tab-home'){show('home');}
    else if(a==='oos-logout'){openService('로그아웃',true);}
    else if(a==='oos-message' ||
            a==='oos-wallet' ||
            a==='oos-alarm' ||
            a==='oos-transfer' ||
            a==='oos-irp' ||
            a==='oos-appcard' ||
            a==='oos-get-coupon' ||
            a==='oos-event' ||
            a==='oos-coupon' ||
            a==='oos-point' ||
            a==='oos-spend-detail' ||
            a==='oos-my-point' ||
            a==='oos-connect-event' ||
            a==='oos-easy-home' ||
            a==='oos-home-setting' ||
            a==='oos-hide-amount' ||
            a==='oos-tab-finance' ||
            a==='oos-tab-goods' ||
            a==='oos-tab-benefit' ||
            a==='oos-tab-stock' ||
            a==='oos-chat' ||
            a==='oos-settings' ||
            a==='oos-ask-ai' ||
            a==='oos-support' ||
            a==='oos-bill-inquiry' ||
            a==='oos-giro-register' ||
            a==='oos-info-support' ||
            a==='oos-done-support'){
      openService(el.textContent.trim());
    }
  });

  buildPad(keys);
  renderPw();
  renderSearch();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
```
